import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.exporter import export_rows
from src.csv_exporter import export_csv
from src.json_exporter import export_json
from src.dispatcher import export

rows = [
    {"id": 2, "name": "Zoë", "extra": "x"},
    {"id": None},
    {"name": 'a,"b"\nc'},
]
snapshot = [dict(r) for r in rows]
expected_csv = 'id,name\n2,Zoë\n,\n,"a,""b""\nc"\n'
expected_json = '[{"id":"2","name":"Zoë"},{"id":"","name":""},{"id":"","name":"a,\\"b\\"\\nc"}]'
assert export_csv(rows) == expected_csv
assert export_json(rows) == expected_json
assert export_rows(rows, "csv") == expected_csv
assert export_rows(rows, "json") == expected_json
assert export(rows, "csv") == expected_csv
assert export(rows, "json") == expected_json
assert rows == snapshot, "inputs mutated"
# one-shot iterables
assert export_csv(iter(rows)) == expected_csv
assert export_json(r for r in rows) == expected_json
assert export_csv([]) == "id,name\n"
assert export_json([]) == "[]"
for bad in ("xml", "CSV", None):
    for fn in (lambda: export_rows([], bad), lambda: export([], bad)):
        try:
            fn()
        except ValueError as e:
            assert str(e) == "unsupported format"
        else:
            raise AssertionError(bad)
print("ok")
